greet.speaker: Officer
greet.text: Evening. What’re you up to around here, eh?

casual.speaker: Officer
casual.text: Heh, same old. Just… keepin’ an eye on things, y’know? Anyway, I’ll be grabbin’ these today.

formal.speaker: Officer
formal.text: Relax… don’t get me wrong, I’m off duty… but I see everything around here. I’ll be buying these today.

silence.speaker: Officer
silence.text: Hmm… quiet type, eh? Fine, I’ll be getting these today.
